Oracle Fusion Project Management 26B: what changed

We track 9 Project Management changes in 26B, out of 9 features (our count) in Oracle's 26B What's New documents for this area. 5 of them are delivered switched on; 4 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Delivered switched on (5)

Labor Commitment Integration from Third-Party Payroll Sources

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Project ManagementProject Management · Cost Management and Control
Labor commitments can now be imported from a third-party payroll's encumbrance data and distributed to projects through the existing labor distribution flow, reserving budget for expected payroll costs and liquidating it as actuals post. Pay elements and labor schedules must be set up first.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Labor Costing by Project Role

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onProject ManagementProject Management · Cost Management and Control
Cost project labor hours using project role-based rates. Labor costing by project role enables precise cost tracking and margin analysis by aligning actual labor costs with project roles used in planning and billing, resulting in improved accuracy and decision making.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Overridden Rate Retention During Financial Plan Rate Refresh

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Project ManagementProject Management · Planning, Scheduling, and Forecasting
Refresh cost, revenue, and burdened rates on financial project plans, budgets, and forecasts while preserving user-overridden rates at the periodic or line level.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Service Excellence Continuing Investments for Billing and Revenue Management

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Project ManagementProject Management · Billing and Revenue Management
For customers opted in to the Bill Transaction Creation on Cost Import feature, bill transactions are now automatically created for complex funding scenarios, such as when costs are funded by multiple contract lines or contracts.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Action History for Bill Transactions

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProject ManagementProject Management · Billing and Revenue Management
Review which actions have been performed on a bill transaction, when, by whom, and why. New user experiences provide a detailed, chronological audit trail of all actions associated with bill transactions, making it easier to understand why transactions are in their current state or why specific actions have failed.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Needs setup or opt-in (4)

Replacement Nomination Approval Workflow

Impact on upgrade: mediumOpt-in, expires 26DProject ManagementProject Management · Resource Management
Allow project managers to approve or reject nominated replacement resources directly from actionable notifications. Resources and stakeholders are notified of assignment changes timely, increasing transparency and strengthening collaboration in the resource assignment process.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Opt In · Oracle source

Award-Specific Viewer Access

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Grant Management
Assign view-only access to specific awards, rather than access to all awards within a business unit. For example, a user can have edit access to one award while having view-only access to another award.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Invoice Grouping Rules

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Billing and Revenue Management
Define simple, reusable rules to group transactions into invoices based on combinations of common attributes, such as project and top task. Align billing to customer preferences by controlling how transactions consolidate into invoices.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Unprocessed Project Cost Exception Control for Predefined Sources

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Cost Management and Control
Update or delete unprocessed project cost exceptions from predefined transaction sources, such as Oracle Fusion Payables and Oracle Fusion Time and Labor, directly in the Manage Unprocessed Costs page.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source
